title: Queen for the Corner
setup: Your bishop on h4 rakes e7, and the black king is shut in by its own pawns on f7 and g7.
hint: Mate needs the king on f8, not g8. What is the price of putting it there, and is it worth paying?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxf8+}} forces {{Kxf8}} — nothing else can take. On f8 the king has e7 covered by the bishop and f7 and g7 blocked by its own pawns, so {{Rd8#}} is mate. A queen is cheap when the alternative is nothing.
